clean_description: The Wizard of Earthsea follows Ged, a young boy with innate magical abilities, who becomes an apprentice to a powerful wizard. As he grows into adulthood, Ged must confront the dark forces he inadvertently unleashed upon the world, learning about the balance of power and the importance of self-acceptance. This coming-of-age story explores themes of identity and the consequences of one's actions.
setting: the archipelago of Earthsea, a fantasy world
